label: Boundary-centered Rust lifetimes
default: normal opening quote in its own cell under calt
toggle: ss01 shifts lifetime quote to boundary and < / & one cell right; works independently of calt

recipe.policy: ASCII apostrophe before identifier starts; quoted identifiers up to 32 letters/digits retain normal quote. Nearby-character heuristic does not parse source strings/comments.
recipe.pair_fitting: Center of opening quote sits on boundary before following character cell; < and & shift exactly600units right. Original advances retained.
recipe.default: Opening single quote in its normal cell under calt; compact placement disabled by default.
